verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a cloud meeting-recording SaaS like Fathom, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored. The listed admin features (SSO/SCIM, view permissions) are access controls, not residency controls, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
